title: Whose Secret Is It Anyway?
story: The web service cannot read its own environment file because root owns it. Giving everyone access would work, in the same sense that removing the front door fixes a lost key.
objective: Make /srv/web/secrets.env owned by web with mode 640: owner read/write, group read, and no access for others.
hints: stat shows the current owner and permission mode.
chown changes ownership; chmod changes permissions.
Use chown web secrets.env and chmod 640 secrets.env.
explanation: Ownership and permissions solve different parts of access control. chown assigns responsibility; mode 640 grants the owner read/write, the group read-only, and everyone else nothing.
